  #README 
  The following .Rmd notebook contains code to reproduce the key results of the LC global extreme precipitation indicator. 

[2026 Report]
Start by downloading the reproducibility folder.
I. Download 1961-20xx (most recent full year) ERA Land monthly hourly precip data globally from Copernicus (https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/datasets/reanalysis-era5-land?tab=overview), move to external drive. 
Load packages and specify paths using the "here" package to direct to the root directory (see below)
II. Process 12 months of hourly summaries into 1 year of daily summaries
III. Convert Zipped Annual Hourly Precip Data .NC into Annual Daily Data TIF (RUN ONCE)
IV. COMPUTE BASELINE PERIOD 1961-1990 EXTREME PRECIP THRESHOLDS (PARALLELIZED, RUN ONCE)
V. Calculate Annual Extreme Event Exceedance Counts for Latest Year(s) (ex. 2024, 2025)
VI. Calculate Annual Extreme Event Exceedance Counts for 1961-2023 (ONLY RUN ONCE, THEN LOAD SAVED EXCEEDANCE COUNTS)
VII. ANALYSIS STEP
VIII. Final extreme precip day count and diff world maps (post Paris minus pre Paris decades)

DATA DESCRIPTION: ERA Land prcp 
https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/cdsapp#!/dataset/reanalysis-era5-land?tab=overview
Total precipitation	m	Accumulated liquid and frozen water, including rain and snow, that falls to the Earth's surface. It is the sum of large-scale precipitation (that precipitation which is generated by large-scale weather patterns, such as troughs and cold fronts) and convective precipitation (generated by convection which occurs when air at lower levels in the atmosphere is warmer and less dense than the air above, so it rises). Precipitation variables do not include fog, dew or the precipitation that evaporates in the atmosphere before it lands at the surface of the Earth. This variable is accumulated from the beginning of the forecast time to the end of the forecast step. The units of precipitation are depth in metres. It is the depth the water would have if it were spread evenly over the grid box. Care should be taken when comparing model variables with observations, because observations are often local to a particular point in space and time, rather than representing averages over a model grid box and model time step.

#UPDATES
#2026 Report
Downloaded most recent year of precip data
Introduced more extreme (>once per year, >once per 5-year, and >once per 10-year) daily precipitation thresholds 
Applied these to all prior years (1961-2025) using the 00:00 accumulated daily precipitation data
Introduced additional pre-Paris decade baseline vs. post-Paris decade comparison

#2027 Report
Disaggregate population-weighted results by country, WHO, and LC regions

#II. Process 12 months of hourly summaries into 1 year of daily summaries
#NOTE: ERA LAND hourly stores precipitation as a daily accumulation with 00:00 (layers 1, 25, 49, etc) corresponding to the 24 hour total from the prior day.
```{r}
#****RUN ONCE PER NEW YEAR TO CONVERT MONTHLY HOURLY ERA-LAND PRECIP (.NC)
#INTO ONE ANNUAL DAILY TOTAL PRECIPITATION (.TIF) Note: faster to not parallelize   

library(terra)
library(data.table)

#=========================================================
#USER SETTINGS
#=========================================================
root_dir <- paste0("/Volumes/Expansion/tp/",new_year,"_Monthly_Hrly")
year_out_dir <- "/Volumes/Expansion/tp/2024_20xx"
tmp_dir  <- "~/Desktop/LC_Downloads/ERA5_Land/prp/terra_prp"

root_dir <- path.expand(root_dir)
tmp_dir  <- path.expand(tmp_dir)

dir.create(tmp_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

terra::terraOptions(tempdir = tmp_dir, memfrac = 0.80)
terra::gdalCache(32768)
data.table::setDTthreads(1)

#If TRUE, convert units from m to mm in the output tif
convert_to_mm <- TRUE

#If TRUE, delete original monthly .nc files after successful annual tif write
delete_monthly_nc_after_success <- FALSE

#=========================================================
#FIND MONTHLY NC FILES
#=========================================================
nc_files <- list.files(
  path = root_dir,
  pattern = "\\.nc$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

nc_files <- sort(nc_files)

if (length(nc_files) == 0) {
  stop("No .nc files found under: ", root_dir)
}

message("Found ", length(nc_files), " monthly .nc files.")

#=========================================================
#PARSE YEAR FROM FILENAMES (fallback)
#=========================================================
years_found <- unique(as.integer(gsub(".*(19[0-9]{2}|20[0-9]{2}).*", "\\1", basename(nc_files))))
years_found <- years_found[!is.na(years_found)]

if (length(years_found) != 1) {
  warning("Could not uniquely parse a single year from filenames. Will try to infer from raster time metadata.")
}

#=========================================================
#HELPER: EXTRACT DAILY 00 UTC LAYERS FROM ONE MONTHLY NC
#=========================================================
extract_daily_tp_one_month <- function(nc_f, convert_to_mm = TRUE) {
  library(terra)

  terra::terraOptions(tempdir = tmp_dir, memfrac = 0.80)
  terra::gdalCache(32768)

  r_meta <- terra::rast(nc_f)
  nl <- terra::nlyr(r_meta)

  tt <- tryCatch(terra::time(r_meta), error = function(e) NULL)

  if (!is.null(tt) && length(tt) == nl && inherits(tt, c("POSIXct", "Date"))) {
    hrs <- as.integer(format(tt, "%H"))
    idx <- which(hrs == 0L)

    if (length(idx) == 0) {
      stop("No 00 UTC layers found in monthly file: ", nc_f)
    }

    r_daily <- terra::rast(nc_f, lyrs = idx)
    terra::time(r_daily) <- as.Date(as.POSIXct(tt[idx], tz = "UTC"))

  } else {
    # Fallback: assume first layer is 00 UTC and then every 24th layer
    idx <- seq(1L, nl, by = 24L)
    r_daily <- terra::rast(nc_f, lyrs = idx)
  }

  if (convert_to_mm) {
    r_daily <- r_daily * 1000
    names(r_daily) <- paste0("tp_mm_", seq_len(terra::nlyr(r_daily)))
  } else {
    names(r_daily) <- paste0("tp_m_", seq_len(terra::nlyr(r_daily)))
  }

  r_daily
}

#=========================================================
#STEP 1: BUILD MONTHLY DAILY RASTERS IN TEMP SPACE
#=========================================================
tmp_month_dir <- file.path(tmp_dir, "monthly_daily_tmp")
dir.create(tmp_month_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

monthly_daily_files <- vector("character", length(nc_files))

for (i in seq_along(nc_files)) {
  nc_f <- nc_files[i]
  message("--------------------------------------------------")
  message("Processing monthly file: ", basename(nc_f))

  # Create deterministic temp monthly tif
  month_stub <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(nc_f))
  month_out  <- file.path(tmp_month_dir, paste0(month_stub, "_daily.tif"))

  if (file.exists(month_out) && file.info(month_out)$size > 0) {
    message("Monthly daily tif already exists, reusing: ", basename(month_out))
    monthly_daily_files[i] <- month_out
    next
  }

  r_daily <- extract_daily_tp_one_month(nc_f, convert_to_mm = convert_to_mm)

  terra::writeRaster(
    r_daily,
    filename = month_out,
    overwrite = TRUE,
    wopt = list(
      datatype = "FLT4S",
      gdal = c("TILED=YES", "COMPRESS=NONE", "BIGTIFF=YES")
    )
  )

  monthly_daily_files[i] <- month_out
  rm(r_daily)
  gc()

  message("Finished monthly daily tif: ", basename(month_out))
}

#=========================================================
#STEP 2: STACK ALL MONTHLY DAILY TIFFS INTO ONE ANNUAL DAILY RASTER
#=========================================================
monthly_daily_files <- monthly_daily_files[file.exists(monthly_daily_files)]
if (length(monthly_daily_files) == 0) {
  stop("No monthly daily tif intermediates were created.")
}

annual_stack <- terra::rast(monthly_daily_files)

#Try to infer year from time metadata first
tt_annual <- tryCatch(terra::time(annual_stack), error = function(e) NULL)

if (!is.null(tt_annual) && length(tt_annual) > 0) {
  annual_years <- unique(format(as.Date(tt_annual), "%Y"))
  annual_years <- annual_years[!is.na(annual_years)]

  if (length(annual_years) == 1) {
    out_year <- annual_years
  } else if (length(years_found) == 1) {
    out_year <- years_found
  } else {
    stop("Could not uniquely determine output year from monthly data.")
  }
} else {
  if (length(years_found) == 1) {
    out_year <- years_found
  } else {
    stop("Could not determine output year from filenames or raster time metadata.")
  }
}

out_year <- as.character(out_year)

#Same annual naming convention as before
annual_out <- file.path(year_out_dir, paste0(out_year, "_era5land_precip.tif"))

terra::writeRaster(
  annual_stack,
  filename = annual_out,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  wopt = list(
    datatype = "FLT4S",
    gdal = c("TILED=YES", "COMPRESS=NONE", "BIGTIFF=YES")
  )
)

message("--------------------------------------------------")
message("Annual daily precipitation tif written: ", annual_out)
message("Number of daily layers in annual tif: ", terra::nlyr(annual_stack))

#=========================================================
#STEP 3: DELETE ORIGINAL MONTHLY NC FILES ONLY AFTER SUCCESS
#=========================================================
if (delete_monthly_nc_after_success && file.exists(annual_out) && file.info(annual_out)$size > 0) {
  message("Deleting original monthly .nc files...")
  unlink(nc_files, force = TRUE)
  message("Deleted ", length(nc_files), " monthly .nc files.")
}

#=========================================================
#STEP 4: OPTIONAL CLEANUP OF TEMP MONTHLY DAILY TIFFS
#=========================================================
unlink(tmp_month_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)

#Final object info
print(annual_stack)
message("Completed annual daily precipitation conversion for year ", out_year)
```

#V. Calculate Annual Extreme Event Exceedance Counts for Latest Year(s)
```{r}
# =========================================================
# ANNUAL EXCEEDANCE COUNTS FOR LATEST YEAR 
# =========================================================
library(terra)
library(parallel)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)

#=========================================================
#USER SETTINGS
#=========================================================
dir_20xx <- "/Volumes/Expansion/tp/2024_20xx" #select directory for latest year

#Threshold rasters produced in the previous chunk
threshold_dir <- paste0(path,"/extreme_thresholds_1961_1990")
thr_1yr_file  <- file.path(threshold_dir, "ERALand_tp_threshold_1yr_1961_1990_mm_day.tif")
thr_5yr_file  <- file.path(threshold_dir, "ERALand_tp_threshold_5yr_1961_1990_mm_day.tif")
thr_10yr_file <- file.path(threshold_dir, "ERALand_tp_threshold_10yr_1961_1990_mm_day.tif")

#Output directories: one per threshold
out_dir_1yr  <- paste0(path,"/extreme_precip_exceedance_counts/exceedance_count_1yr")
out_dir_5yr  <- paste0(path,"/extreme_precip_exceedance_counts/exceedance_count_5yr")
out_dir_10yr <- paste0(path,"/extreme_precip_exceedance_counts/exceedance_count_10yr")

dir.create(out_dir_1yr,  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(out_dir_5yr,  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(out_dir_10yr, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

tmp_dir <- "~/Desktop/2024_LC_Downloads/ERA5_Land/prp/terra_prp"
terra::terraOptions(tempdir = tmp_dir, memfrac = 0.80)
terra::gdalCache(32768)
data.table::setDTthreads(1)

#Do not exceed 6
mc_cores <- 6

#Explicit unit declarations
#Set to how annual daily tifs and thresholds are stored
daily_tifs_in_mm   <- TRUE
thresholds_in_mm   <- TRUE

#Set TRUE to run a sanity-check plot before the parallel processing
run_sanity_check_plot <- TRUE

#=========================================================
#START TIMER
#=========================================================
chunk_start_time <- Sys.time()

#=========================================================
#FILE LISTS
#=========================================================
#Adjust pattern if needed to isolate only the annual daily-total tifs
files_20xx <- sort(list.files(
  dir_20xx,
  pattern = "^[0-9]{4}_era5land_precip\\.tif$",
  full.names = TRUE
))

all_files <- c(files_20xx)

#Keep only years >2000 based on filename
extract_year <- function(x) as.integer(gsub(".*(20[0-9]{2}).*", "\\1", basename(x)))
file_years <- extract_year(all_files)

keep <- !is.na(file_years) & file_years > (new_year - 1)
all_files <- all_files[keep]
file_years <- file_years[keep]

#One file per year expected
stopifnot(length(unique(file_years)) == 1)

#Keep files sorted by year
ord <- order(file_years)
all_files <- all_files[ord]
file_years <- file_years[ord]

message("Annual daily tif files found for years: ", min(file_years), "-", max(file_years))

#=========================================================
#LOAD THRESHOLD RASTERS
#=========================================================
thr_1yr  <- terra::rast(thr_1yr_file)
thr_5yr  <- terra::rast(thr_5yr_file)
thr_10yr <- terra::rast(thr_10yr_file)

#=========================================================
#HELPER: CHECK RASTER GEOMETRY MATCH
#=========================================================
check_geometry_match <- function(r, thr, year_label, thr_label, tol = 1e-4) {

  if (!terra::same.crs(r, thr)) {
    stop("CRS mismatch for year ", year_label, " and threshold ", thr_label)
  }

  if (!identical(dim(r)[1:2], dim(thr)[1:2])) {
    stop(
      "Dimension mismatch for year ", year_label, " and threshold ", thr_label,
      " | raster dims = ", paste(dim(r)[1:2], collapse = " x "),
      " | threshold dims = ", paste(dim(thr)[1:2], collapse = " x ")
    )
  }

  res_r <- terra::res(r)
  res_t <- terra::res(thr)

  if (any(abs(res_r - res_t) > tol)) {
    stop(
      "Resolution mismatch for year ", year_label, " and threshold ", thr_label,
      " | raster res = ", paste(format(res_r, digits = 16), collapse = ", "),
      " | threshold res = ", paste(format(res_t, digits = 16), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  ext_r <- c(terra::xmin(r), terra::xmax(r), terra::ymin(r), terra::ymax(r))
  ext_t <- c(terra::xmin(thr), terra::xmax(thr), terra::ymin(thr), terra::ymax(thr))

  if (any(abs(ext_r - ext_t) > tol)) {
    stop(
      "Extent mismatch for year ", year_label, " and threshold ", thr_label,
      " | raster extent = ", paste(format(ext_r, digits = 16), collapse = ", "),
      " | threshold extent = ", paste(format(ext_t, digits = 16), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  TRUE
}

#=========================================================
#HELPER: MATCH UNITS
#=========================================================
match_units_if_needed <- function(r) {

  if (daily_tifs_in_mm == thresholds_in_mm) {
    return(r)
  }

  daily_unit <- if (daily_tifs_in_mm) "mm/day" else "m/day"
  thr_unit   <- if (thresholds_in_mm) "mm/day" else "m/day"

  warning(
    paste0(
      "Unit mismatch detected: ",
      "daily precipitation rasters are in [", daily_unit, "] ",
      "but threshold rasters are in [", thr_unit, "]. ",
      "No conversion has been applied. Proceed with caution."
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )

  return(r)
}

#=========================================================
#SANITY-CHECK PLOT ON FIRST YEAR BEFORE PARALLEL RUN
#=========================================================
if (run_sanity_check_plot) {
  test_file <- all_files[1]
  test_year <- file_years[1]

  message("Running sanity-check plot on year: ", test_year)

  r_test <- terra::rast(test_file)
  r_test <- match_units_if_needed(r_test)
  
  # plot(thr_1yr[[1]])
  # plot(r_test[[1]])
  # 
  # terra::res(thr_1yr)
  # terra::res(r_test)

  check_geometry_match(r_test[[1]], thr_1yr,  test_year, "1yr")
  check_geometry_match(r_test[[1]], thr_5yr,  test_year, "5yr")
  check_geometry_match(r_test[[1]], thr_10yr, test_year, "10yr")

  # Example diagnostics:
  # annual max daily precip
  annual_max <- terra::app(r_test, fun = "max", na.rm = TRUE)

  # annual exceedance count for 1-year threshold
  annual_exc_1yr <- terra::app(r_test > thr_1yr, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)

  par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
  plot(annual_max, main = paste0(test_year, " annual max daily precip"))
  plot(thr_1yr, main = "1-year threshold (baseline)")
  plot(annual_exc_1yr, main = paste0(test_year, " exceedance count > 1-year"))
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

  message("Sanity-check plot completed. Inspect before continuing.")
}

#=========================================================
#HELPER: PROCESS ONE YEAR
#=========================================================
process_one_year <- function(f, yr) {
  library(terra)

  terra::terraOptions(tempdir = tmp_dir, memfrac = 0.80)
  terra::gdalCache(32768)

  Sys.sleep(runif(1, 0, 3))

  r <- terra::rast(f)
  r <- match_units_if_needed(r)

  check_geometry_match(r[[1]], thr_1yr,  yr, "1yr")
  check_geometry_match(r[[1]], thr_5yr,  yr, "5yr")
  check_geometry_match(r[[1]], thr_10yr, yr, "10yr")

  f1  <- file.path(out_dir_1yr,  paste0(yr, "_1yr_exceedance_count.tif"))
  f5  <- file.path(out_dir_5yr,  paste0(yr, "_5yr_exceedance_count.tif"))
  f10 <- file.path(out_dir_10yr, paste0(yr, "_10yr_exceedance_count.tif"))

  if (!file.exists(f1) || file.info(f1)$size == 0) {
    exc_1yr <- terra::app(r > thr_1yr, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)
    names(exc_1yr) <- paste0("exceed_count_", yr, "_1yr")
    terra::writeRaster(
      exc_1yr,
      filename = f1,
      overwrite = TRUE,
      wopt = list(
        datatype = "INT2U",
        gdal = c("TILED=YES", "COMPRESS=ZSTD", "BIGTIFF=YES")
      )
    )
    rm(exc_1yr)
    gc()
    elapsed <- difftime(Sys.time(), chunk_start_time, units = "mins")
    message("Saved: ", basename(f1), " | elapsed since chunk start: ", round(as.numeric(elapsed), 2), " min")
  }

  if (!file.exists(f5) || file.info(f5)$size == 0) {
    exc_5yr <- terra::app(r > thr_5yr, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)
    names(exc_5yr) <- paste0("exceed_count_", yr, "_5yr")
    terra::writeRaster(
      exc_5yr,
      filename = f5,
      overwrite = TRUE,
      wopt = list(
        datatype = "INT2U",
        gdal = c("TILED=YES", "COMPRESS=ZSTD", "BIGTIFF=YES")
      )
    )
    rm(exc_5yr)
    gc()
    elapsed <- difftime(Sys.time(), chunk_start_time, units = "mins")
    message("Saved: ", basename(f5), " | elapsed since chunk start: ", round(as.numeric(elapsed), 2), " min")
  }

  if (!file.exists(f10) || file.info(f10)$size == 0) {
    exc_10yr <- terra::app(r > thr_10yr, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)
    names(exc_10yr) <- paste0("exceed_count_", yr, "_10yr")
    terra::writeRaster(
      exc_10yr,
      filename = f10,
      overwrite = TRUE,
      wopt = list(
        datatype = "INT2U",
        gdal = c("TILED=YES", "COMPRESS=ZSTD", "BIGTIFF=YES")
      )
    )
    rm(exc_10yr)
    gc()
    elapsed <- difftime(Sys.time(), chunk_start_time, units = "mins")
    message("Saved: ", basename(f10), " | elapsed since chunk start: ", round(as.numeric(elapsed), 2), " min")
  }

  rm(r)
  gc()

  c(f1, f5, f10)
}

#=========================================================
#PARALLEL RUN ACROSS YEARS
#=========================================================
out_files <- parallel::mclapply(
  seq_along(all_files),
  function(i) process_one_year(all_files[i], file_years[i]),
  mc.cores = mc_cores
)

out_files <- unlist(out_files)

message("Completed annual exceedance count processing for ", length(unique(file_years)), " years.")
```

#Compute and Plot Results for 1-Year, 5-Year, and 10-Year Extreme Precipitation Event Counts
```{r}
#Load 1961-20xx Annual 1-Year, 5-Year and 10-Year Count Spatrasters #*** including new year 

#set exceedance directory path (fixed)
dir_base <- paste0(path, "/extreme_precip_exceedance_counts/")

load_exceedance_stack <- function(dir_path, suffix_pattern) {
  dir_path <- path.expand(dir_path)

  pat <- paste0("^[0-9]{4}_", suffix_pattern, "_exceedance_count\\.tif$")
  f <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = pat, full.names = TRUE)

  yrs <- as.integer(sub("^([0-9]{4})_.*$", "\\1", basename(f)))
  ord <- order(yrs)

  f <- f[ord]
  yrs <- yrs[ord]

  r <- terra::rast(f)
  names(r) <- paste0("y", yrs)

  list(rast = r, years = yrs, files = f)
}

# Example paths
dir_1yr  <- paste0(dir_base,"exceedance_count_1yr")
dir_5yr  <- paste0(dir_base,"exceedance_count_5yr")
dir_10yr <- paste0(dir_base,"exceedance_count_10yr")

# Load
out_1yr  <- load_exceedance_stack(dir_1yr,  "1yr")
out_5yr  <- load_exceedance_stack(dir_5yr,  "5yr")
out_10yr <- load_exceedance_stack(dir_10yr, "10yr")

exc_1yr  <- out_1yr$rast
exc_5yr  <- out_5yr$rast
exc_10yr <- out_10yr$rast

# Check
r1yr_1961_20xx <- exc_1yr
r5yr_1961_20xx <- exc_5yr
r10yr_1961_20xx <- exc_10yr

r1yr_1961_20xx
r5yr_1961_20xx
r10yr_1961_20xx

# #integrate newest year *ADD new years
# exc_new_1yr <- terra::rast(".nc")
# exc_new_5yr <- terra::rast(".nc")
# exc_new_10yr <- terra::rast(".nc")

# #align rasters
# crs(exc_new_1yr) <- crs(exc_1yr) #match CRS
# crs(exc_new_5yr) <- crs(exc_5yr) #match CRS
# crs(exc_new_10yr) <- crs(exc_10yr) #match CRS
# 
# #combine 1961-2025 and most recent year rasters
# r1yr_1961_20xx<-c(exc_1yr,exc_new_1yr)
# r5yr_1961_20xx<-c(exc_5yr,exc_new_5yr)
# r10yr_1961_20xx<-c(exc_10yr,exc_new_10yr)
# 
# #confirm layer order is consistent
# plot(exc_1yr[[65]])
# plot(r1yr_1961_20xx[[65]])

rm(exc_1yr,exc_new_1yr)
rm(exc_5yr,exc_new_5yr)
rm(exc_10yr,exc_new_10yr)
gc()

#correct meta-data and raster alignment
varnames(r1yr_1961_20xx) <- "r1yr_days"
varnames(r5yr_1961_20xx) <- "r5yr_days"
varnames(r10yr_1961_20xx) <- "r10yr_days"

#Load and process GPWv4 population data
# load in gpw v4----
# download from here: https://sedac.ciesin.columbia.edu/data/set/gpw-v4-population-count-rev11/data-download
data_directory <- paste0(path,"/LC_Preferred_Datasets/")

# years
years <- seq(2000, 2020, by = 5)

# store the raster layers
raster_layers <- list()

for(year in years) {
  zip_file_name <- sprintf("gpw-v4-population-count-rev11_%d_30_sec_tif.zip", year)
  zip_file_path <- file.path(data_directory, zip_file_name)

  if(file.exists(zip_file_path)) {
    temp_dir <- tempdir()
    extracted_files <- unzip(zip_file_path, exdir = temp_dir)
    tif_file <- grep("*.tif$", extracted_files, value = TRUE)
    if(length(tif_file) == 1) {
      raster_layer <- terra::rast(tif_file)
      raster_layers[[as.character(year)]] <- raster_layer
    } else {
      warning(paste("Expected one GeoTIFF file in zip for year", year, "- found none or multiple."))
    }
  } else {
    warning(paste("Zipped file for year", year, "not found: Skipping."))
  }
}

rm(data_directory, raster_layer, extracted_files, file_name, file_path, temp_dir, tif_file, year, years, zip_file_name, zip_file_path)

# make average of gpwv4 across the years 2000-2020----
## gpwv4 yearly values are extrapolated from just one year of actual data
## "Thus, the population estimates for all five years are derived from the same input population data, not from different sources. In addition, the same growth rate is used to extrapolate the data to all target years. As a result, the target years do not reflect a true time series." https://sedac.uservoice.com/knowledgebase/articles/799152-gpwv4-releases-data-for-five-years-2000-2005-20

# stack rasters
raster_stack <- terra::rast(raster_layers)

# take average of raster stack

  labs(title = "Annual fraction of global land area exposed to ~>5-Year (>99.945th percentile) extreme precipitation events 1961-2025",
       x = "Year",
       y = paste0("fraction of land area with annual once-per-5yr. extreme precipitation events 1961-1990 & ",precip_start_year,"-",new_year," (global land area weighted average)")) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(paste0(figpath,"annual_pct_exposure_r5yr_extreme_precip_events_1961_",new_year,".pdf"), width = 10, height = 7.5, units = "in")

setnames(ext_prcp_r5yr,"wtd_avg_r5yr_pct","land_area_weighted_avg_pct_exposure_extreme_r5yr_daily_precipitation_events_exceeding_99.945th_percentile_of_1961_1990_daily_precipitation")
setnames(ext_prcp_r5yr,"baseline_wtd_avg_r5yr_pct","avg_pct_exposure_extreme_r5yr_daily_precipitation_events_during_1961_1990_baseline")
```

```{r}
# ---

r1yr_2006_2015

r1yr_2016_2025
r5yr_2016_2025
r10yr_2016_2025

#set the appropriate metadata
#generate a sequence of dates for intervals

#pre baseline
dates_1996_2005 <- seq(as.Date("1996-01-01"), as.Date("2005-01-01"), by="year")
dates_1996_2005 <- as.character(dates_1996_2005) #convert the sequence to a character vector

#pre Paris
dates_2006_2015 <- seq(as.Date("2006-01-01"), as.Date("2015-01-01"), by="year")
dates_2006_2015 <- as.character(dates_2006_2015) #convert the sequence to a character vector

#after Paris
dates_2016_2025 <- seq(as.Date("2016-01-01"), as.Date("2025-01-01"), by="year")
dates_2016_2025 <- as.character(dates_2016_2025) #convert the sequence to a character vector

#set date: year
names(r1yr_1996_2005) <- dates_1996_2005 
names(r1yr_2006_2015) <- dates_2006_2015 
names(r1yr_2016_2025) <- dates_2016_2025 

names(r5yr_1996_2005) <- dates_1996_2005
names(r5yr_2006_2015) <- dates_2006_2015 
names(r5yr_2016_2025) <- dates_2016_2025 

names(r10yr_1996_2005) <- dates_1996_2005 
names(r10yr_2006_2015) <- dates_2006_2015 
names(r10yr_2016_2025) <- dates_2016_2025 

#------ compute indicators for Pre and Post PARIS Decades

#Mean decadal SUM of extreme p events during 2006-2015 and 2016-2025
#r5yr 
sum_r5yr_2006_2015 <- app(r5yr_2006_2015, fun=sum, na.rm=T, cores=24) #sum r5yr counts as single 10 yr base raster
sum_r5yr_2016_2025 <- app(r5yr_2016_2025, fun=sum, na.rm=T, cores=24) #sum r5yr counts as single 10 2016_2025 recent raster
sum_r5yr_2006_2015
sum_r5yr_2016_2025

#r10yr 
sum_r10yr_2006_2015 <- app(r10yr_2006_2015, fun=sum, na.rm=T, cores=24) #avg r10yr counts as single 30 yr base raster
sum_r10yr_2016_2025 <- app(r10yr_2016_2025, fun=sum, na.rm=T, cores=24) #avg r10yr counts as single 30 yr raster 2016_2025 raster
sum_r10yr_2006_2015
sum_r10yr_2016_2025

#***
#2026 Paris Report
sum_r10yr_2016_2025
sum_r10yr_2006_2015

plot(sum_r5yr_2016_2025[[1]])
plot(sum_r10yr_2016_2025[[1]])

#plot number of extreme precipitation events in past 5 and 10 years
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf) # For coordinate transformation

#I. 5years
sum_r5yr_2016_2025
plot(sum_r5yr_2016_2025[[1]])

#Convert SpatRaster to data frame
sum_r5yr_2016_2025_plot <- terra::as.data.frame(
  sum_r5yr_2016_2025,
  xy = TRUE,
  na.rm = FALSE
)

#Existing palette
colors <- c(
  "grey90",
  "#7acfea",
  "#22aae0",
  "#1775bc",
  "#1650a5",
  "#15006b",
  "#060028"
)

#Preserve the existing color anchors through 10
color_values <- c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10)

ggplot(
  sum_r5yr_2016_2025_plot,
  aes(x = x, y = y, fill = sum)
) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = colors,

    #Explicitly rescale the color anchors over 0–10
    values = scales::rescale(
      color_values,
      from = c(0, 10)
    ),

    #Display and map the scale over 0–10
    limits = c(0, 10),

    #Give all observations >10 the color assigned to 10
    oob = scales::squish,

    breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10),
    labels = c("0", "2", "4", "6", "8", "10+"),

    na.value = "white",

    guide = guide_colorbar(
      title = "#days w/ extreme >5yr precip",
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5
    )
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    crs = st_crs("+proj=eck3"),
    xlim = c(-180, 180),
    ylim = c(-90, 90)
  ) +
  labs(title = "# greater-than 5yr extreme precipitation events") +
  theme_minimal()

#save map as pdf and png
```
